items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: for me it was like Georgie Auld homecoming because I hadn't seen Georgie Auld, and -- nor worked with him in so long

ctx.x: Most of the Times us (inaudible) we've used first names that are so well known --

Yes, so you know, I forget. But any way this was an unusual recording, and for me it was like Georgie Auld homecoming because I hadn't seen Georgie Auld, and -- nor worked with him in so long, since -- actually I hadn't worked with him since the Street. Now, you know what the street is, 52nd Street. Okay, now -- and Georgie -- he's a giant. You know, the warmth there, it was just-- I mean, musically the warmth of there was just permeating the whole studio. So it was kind of a nice thing. And they took a lot of…
We got into a thing -- they took this out of -- and put it out as a single. That was very -- I have quite a few solos on that.
